title: INSTANT COOL FAST HIT AUTO UPGRADE
features:
Boosts the hit speed of your best (valid) towers which causes a seemingly instant "cool" or "kill" on the baddie, automatically upgrades baddies when you have enough cash, be sure to read the settings info if you plan to mess with any settings

Supports ALL executors

Features:
• Fast Hit
• Instant Kill
• Auto Upgrade
script:
getgenv().Settings = { -- **WARNING** : messing with some of these settings can cause your game to lag, so I recommend keeping them the default value (or lowering them due to lag) but the option to experiment is there
	autoUpgrade = true, -- if true, the script will automatically upgrade the baddies for you when you have enough cash
	maxTowers = 3, -- the maximum number of towers that can be damage boosted for the insta kill, if you experience lag issues, set this value LOWER
	boostIntensity = 4, -- the intensity of the damage boost, if you experience lag issues, set this value LOWER
}

loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raxscripts/LuaUscripts/refs/heads/main/CoolABaddie.lua"))()
